subject_name: Technical Writing and Soft Skill / Capstone Project
description: Equips engineering professionals with technical writing mastery, academic publishing ethics, research documentation standards, corporate communication, and capstone project execution.
learning_objectives: Write structured technical reports, research papers, and technical proposals in IEEE/ACM formats.
Master citation tools, literature survey methodologies, and plagiarism-free academic documentation.
Develop executive presentation skills, interpersonal communication, and team leadership.
Formulate, execute, and document an industry capstone project case study.
outline: Principles of Technical Writing: Clarity, precision, audience analysis, tone, and grammatical coherence in technical documentation.
Research & Academic Documentation: Writing research papers, literature surveys, technical reports, IEEE/ACM conference format styling, and citations (BibTeX/Zotero).
Professional & Business Communication: Executive summaries, proposal writing, documentation for software systems, and data-driven presentations.
Ethics & Integrity in AI Research: Plagiarism avoidance, ethical publishing, research reproducibility, and peer review processes.
Soft Skills & Professional Leadership: Technical presentations, elevator pitch, interview communication, negotiation, and teamwork dynamics.
Capstone Project Execution: Problem definition, methodology design, implementation milestones, and final thesis report presentation.
